stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 4.

Even today, totem-pole carving continues in Ketchikan, Alaska, where Tlingit Indians still live.

In this sentence, what does the author help the reader understand about the culture of the Tlingit people?

options.label: F
options.text: Their master carvers are highly skilled.

options.label: G
options.text: Their carvers use special tools to make each totem pole.

options.label: H
options.text: Their history is told through images on the totem poles.

options.label: J
options.text: They have maintained their tradition of making totem poles.
